_comment: W12-COMPANION-0904 (addendum E / owner directive C section 5). Tunables for scripts/creatures/companion_presence.gd, the contextual-reaction layer on the player's deployed creature. Every reaction here is presentation over the follower's own locomotion: none of it moves the gameplay body except the short `approach` walk, which goes through the same request_move() the follower uses. All durations/cooldowns are seconds, all distances metres, all angles degrees.
_comment_rigs: Every installed creature rig carries exactly six clips (attack, faint, hit, idle, run, walk) and a `head`/`neck` bone -- tools/_capture_companion_rig_inventory.gd, 2026-09-04. There is no happy/bounce/lie-down clip anywhere in the roster, so every reaction below is procedural motion on the model pivot (hop, nod, wiggle, scale pulse, roll/sink) plus a clip the rig does have, and the head turn is a LookAtModifier3D on the head bone. Nothing here names a clip the roster lacks.

guard._comment: Context in which NO reaction may start and any running one is cut: a fight (aiming included), riding, any panel/menu/dialogue owning input (input_owner.gd), a live actionable interact prompt, the sequence director's lockout, an armed build ghost. `victory_during_resolve` lets the post-victory reaction alone play during combat_manager's RESOLVING pause after a WON fight -- the result beat -- when nothing is piloting the creature any more.

bond._comment: How bond_nodes() (0-5 milestones completed) warms the layer. Each is subtracted/added per node; floors keep bond 5 from making the creature clingy.

acknowledge._comment: The trainer has stood still for `still_seconds` (less at higher bond) while the creature is standing with them: it walks up to `approach_distance`, faces them, dips its head once and holds their gaze. Also fired, without the wait, on deploy (`deploy` event) with its own shorter cooldown.

victory._comment: A won fight's result beat: hops on the spot with a small scale pulse for ~2 s; at `bond.victory_roar_from_node` and above the attack clip plays once as a roar/pounce. If the fight teardown hides the body mid-reaction, the layer queues a `deploy` acknowledgment so the creature turns to the trainer when it reappears beside them.

hurt._comment: Continuous while HP is under `hp_below` or the creature is hungry (creature_condition.is_hungry -- the light-hunger rule; nothing here harms it). Slower gait, a HUNG HEAD (the head bone is aimed at a ground marker just ahead of the creature's own feet rather than at the trainer -- see companion_presence.gd's `_droop_target`), a slowed idle, and a flinch (the rig's own `hit` clip) every `flinch_every_s` +/- `flinch_jitter_s` while standing. `body_pitch_deg` is deliberately small: round 1's 11 degrees tipped the whole animal nose-down and a code-blind critic read the result as 'lying down, resting, or nosing at something on the ground' rather than as injured.

camp._comment: Within `radius` of a camp source (a lit campfire's campfire_glow.gd overlay, a creature_bed.gd or player_bed.gd, or anything in the `companion_camp` group) and standing for `settle_seconds`: tilts toward its species' rest pose (rest_roll_deg * roll_fraction; 0 opts out entirely), grounds that tilt, and idles at half speed. Stands back up the moment it has to move or the trainer leaves. ROLL_FRACTION IS DELIBERATELY MODEST AND THIS IS THE LANE'S RECORDED CEILING. Rolling a STANDING model about the pivot at its own feet is not a lie-down; it is a felled-tree tilt, and the deeper it goes the more of the body swings below the ground plane. 0.45 was read by a code-blind critic as a creature merely standing beside a fire; 0.85 buried it -- 'a head and a paw lying detached in a meadow' -- and a third critic still read it as buried after the grounding SIGN was fixed, because 0.85 leaves 0.21m of the low side underground even when correctly lifted. A convincing rest needs an authored lie-down clip, and tools/_capture_companion_rig_inventory.gd says no rig in the roster has one. 0.35 is a visible settle whose low side is provably at or above ground for every species that opts in, which is the honest thing to ship until such a clip exists. `sink_fraction` is 0 for the same reason: sinking is exactly the failure mode here. tests/test_companion_presence.gd asserts the geometry rather than trusting it to look right.

care._comment: Fed / healed / revived from the satchel (tab_backpack.gd hooks). The menu owns input at that moment, so the reaction is queued and plays the instant the satchel closes: walk up, face the trainer, then feed = two quick hops, heal = a slow stretch (scale pulse) with a nod, revive = a head shake.

bond_milestone._comment: A bond node just completed (polled off bond_nodes(); the `bond_milestone` event from the progression feed, once another lane lands it, is the same entry). The strongest moment the layer owns: walk right up, four rising hops, a pulse, and the roar clip.

look._comment: Head turn toward the trainer via LookAtModifier3D on the rig's `head` bone, while standing within `radius`. `influence` under 1 keeps the idle's own head motion alive under it.
